title: Blokkusus
description: This mod adds 126+ new building blocks!
body:
[![Sparked Host](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1330912431496495165/1490018985675198534/Artboard_2-1.png?ex=69d287d1&is=69d13651&hm=fa99fc9a0f45b09a7ef09ae91ba8f79d8cd7e3b1a06fd73b17010a9561bbfad1&)](https://billing.sparkedhost.com/aff.php?aff=3220)

--- ![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98a4afef4848f6c03a90678d16b54ad67ef426b6.png) You ever sit down to build something and realize vanilla just doesn't have *that one block* you need? The right texture, the right shape, the right vibe — it's almost there, but not quite. That's exactly why Blokkusus exists. No central theme, no gimmick, no forced aesthetic. Just a solid collection of **~50 blocks** that we felt were missing from the game — decorative pieces, structural options, detail work, all the stuff that makes a build go from "pretty good" to "how did they do that." Think of it as a kitchen sink mod, but for people who actually care about what goes in the sink. --- ![whatsinside](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4765870932f6391ccd5d0fa7ba5a88dc3fa3afac.png) Blokkusus doesn't try to reinvent Minecraft. It just fills in the gaps. You'll find blocks that fit naturally alongside what's already in the game — things that *should* have always been there. New textures, new shapes, new combinations. Whether you're detailing a interior, finishing off an exterior, or just experimenting with palettes you couldn't pull off before, there's something here for you. --- ![details](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ecba36343d01bd4e07d60d12fecabc26e8491fc.png) - **~126 new building and decoration blocks (will be more blocks in the future!)** - Designed to complement vanilla Minecraft's existing aesthetics - Built for **Fabric** - Requires **Minecraft 1.21.11 or higher** --- ![helpwiththemod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71de874732b0b864d4bbfc63c8f21a30aae86f55_0.webp) Blokkusus is developed and maintained by **EdonMe Studios**. Found a bug? Got a suggestion? We're open to feedback — drop a comment or reach out and help us grow the mod into something even better. ---
